scientific_question: Do MODIS Aqua and VIIRS NOAA-20 agree about relative monthly/geographic activity, especially 2025/2026?

methods.window: closed UTC calendar months Jan-Oct (2023–2026), same 1° grid and simplified Amazonas polygon
methods.sensor_filters: daytime; MODIS Aqua >=30, NOAA20 n/h, type=0 where available
methods.normalization: Each sensor's original counts in a given year and period divided by its own total for that year and period
methods.total_variation: 0.5*sum absolute differences in relative shares, 0 perfect, 1 maximal
methods.spearman_rho: rank correlation on union of active cells/months; ties receive average ranks
methods.top_k: top 10 one-degree spatial cells per sensor ranked by original counts; overlap/jaccard
methods.baseline: global factor trained on preceding historical year(s), evaluated on held-out 2024/2025 Jan-Oct; no 2026 absolute WAPE because SP/NRT difference
methods.no_target_modis_leakage: share comparison uses both sensors' observed totals for descriptive comparison only, not for predictive calibration
methods.invariance: positive global multiplication of VIIRS count leaves share distribution, ranks and top-k exactly unchanged
